0.1.3.name: Visuals Player
0.1.3.notes:
- Curated visuals that move with four original songs, your microphone or line in, or play silently.
- Control it like a Visual in Live Console: E1–E4 shape the picture in pages, K3 opens Visuals and Visual Settings, K4 opens the Player for sound, track, auto change and camera.
- Auto change picks the next visual on a new section of the song; playing a visual yourself holds it.
- Turn on the camera to steer visuals with your hands and see image visuals use your picture.
- On a device with a second screen, the picture fills that screen while the touch screen keeps the controls.

0.1.4.name: Visuals Player
0.1.4.notes:
- Start in the Playground after about 5 MB: the songs and camera tracking keep loading while the picture plays.
- Keep routine tracking messages out of the browser console's errors.

0.1.5.name: Visuals Player
0.1.5.notes: - Start sooner in the Playground: one download, and the picture plays as soon as its first files arrive.

0.1.6.name: Visuals Player
0.1.6.notes: - Show the camera picture sharp on a large output or second screen: it now arrives at the camera's own size instead of a small, blurry copy.

0.2.0.name: Visuals Player
0.2.0.notes:
- Mute or unmute the music with the speaker button on the device screen; the sound fades out and back in, and the picture keeps the beat.
- Starting the music and switching to Silent or Mic / Line in fade the sound instead of cutting it.

0.3.0.name: Visuals Player
0.3.0.notes: - Turn the camera on or off with the camera button beside mute on the device screen.

0.3.1.name: Visuals Player
0.3.1.notes:
- Keep the speaker button on the device screen with every sound choice: with Silent or Mic / Line in it shows as muted, and a tap plays the music.
- Mark the camera button with a small cross while the camera is off, and colour both buttons the same way: pink while the music plays or the camera is on.

0.3.2.name: Visuals Player
0.3.2.notes: - Install Visuals Player from Official Apps on the device: the release package now matches the package the device checks.
